outcome: Body image (physical attractiveness, weight control, physical fitness)
cohort: The study included 164 women (93 vaginal delivery, 71 caesarean section) aged 18 or older, between 6 weeks and 6 months postpartum.
finding: Women reported moderate satisfaction with their bodies and quite satisfactory sexual quality of life, with sexual activity resuming for half of the women by 12 weeks postpartum.
mod_finding: Resumption of sexual activity within 6 weeks postpartum was low regardless of birth mode, but by 12 weeks, every second woman in both vaginal delivery and caesarean section groups had resumed activity, and the majority did not notice changes in the frequency or quality of their sex life.
cross-section timing: Between 6 weeks and 6 months after childbirth
